original_value: ADATA 256GB XPG SX8200 Pro PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive. Description: The SX8200 Pro M.2 2280 SSD is XPG’s fastest SSD to date and is designed for avid PC enthusiasts, gamers, and overclockers. It features an ultra-fast PCIe Gen3x4 interface that offers peak read/write speeds of 3500/3000MB per second, outpacing SATA 6Gb/s by a wide margin. Supporting NVMe 1.3, the SX8200 Pro delivers excellent random read/write performance and multi-tasking capabilities. With SLC caching, a DRAM Cache buffer, E2E Data Protection, and LDPC ECC, it maintains high speeds and data integrity, even during highly intensive applications such as gaming rendering, and overclocking.Key FeaturesUltra-fast PCIe Gen3x4 interface: R/W speed up to 3500/3000MB/sNVMe 1.3 support3D NAND Flash for higher capacity and durabilityAdvanced LDPC ECC TechnologySLC Caching and DRAM cache buffer
